knowledge.rule: An officer may evaluate only information personally held, shared-service evidence, or a lawful military-institution dossier delivered to that officer. Hidden runtime facts are never attraction inputs.

invariants: No commander receives player-specific attraction logic.
Career preference and petition state never own office, formation, manpower, equipment, or administrative custody.
A state officer remains a state officer unless the existing authoritative allegiance or appointment mechanism changes that fact.
Career petitions request action; they do not teleport personnel or formations.
Formation loyalty is aggregate cohort-scale state on the persistent formation owner; named people retain exact personal state.
Administrative ownership and command authority never change merely because loyalty changes.
Legacy scalar loyalty fields are non-authoritative for military allegiance resolution.
Materialization must reclassify an existing conserved person or cohort member and never create manpower.
Routing pages bound work per wake but never cap total officers, commanders, petitions, formations, or career events.
Crisis allegiance resolves through immediate command relationships and competing loyalty axes rather than a single conversion threshold.
